Feature FEAT_PROVIDER_RETRY (Provider retry)

Technical requirement TREQ_PROVIDER_RETRY_BOUNDS (Same-route provider retry is bounded): For one resolved provider route, provider execution shall perform no more than the configured retry maximum-attempt count before surfacing the final failure to routing. structured.reason: With reraise=False, the attempt count stays the same, but once retries run out Tenacity raises a RetryError wrapper instead of the provider's last exception. Routing then sees a different failure, which breaks the requirement to surface the final failure to routing. Routing logic that checks failure types, such as transient versus permanent, would no longer see the real provider error.

structured.test_focus: Once retries run out, the test must check that the error raised to the caller is the last provider exception itself (same type and instance), not tenacity.RetryError, and that exactly max_attempts calls were made.
